# sideBar

sideBar is an AI assistant for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web browser. It gives
users a single place to take notes, manage tasks, save websites, and work with
files, with an AI that can read all of that content and help get things done.

## Key capabilities

- **Chat**: conversational AI that has access to all your content and context
- **Notes**: full writing environment with folders, rich text, and Scratchpad
- **Tasks**: to-do management with smart lists (Today, Upcoming, Completed)
- **Websites**: read-it-later with offline access and AI integration
- **Files**: document upload and indexing across PDFs, images, audio, video, and more
- **Skills**: extensible capability system, required, standard, and store skills

## AI provider support

sideBar uses your own API key. Supported providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google.
